description: A doc's text (SPEC.md §1): its bytes decoded as UTF-8, without a byte order mark, every line end as LF; `text` null when the bytes are not UTF-8. `written` is the file a tool writes back for that same text: the byte order mark kept, CRLF throughout when the file had any. Bytes are hex.

cases.name: LF lines are the text as it is
CRLF line ends are LF in the text and CRLF on disk
a byte order mark is not in the text and stays on disk
mixed line ends: any CRLF writes CRLF everywhere
a lone CR is a line end
GBK is not UTF-8: not a doc's text
an invalid UTF-8 byte: not a doc's text
